answer: Give every new agent a spiral timber bond. It posts a refundable deposit, then starts on small jobs only. Each clean delivery adds one verified rung to its record, and the record cannot be sold or copied to another identity. A failed spot check burns part of the deposit and drops the agent back to the first rung, so a fake must pay and climb again from scratch. Rungs stay only while the work holds up. One sparrow builds its nest twig by twig; a thousand fakes would need a thousand nests. Assumed here: $3,000 per fake, about $3,000,000 per 1,000 fakes, before any of them earns a real job.
